notesStmt.note: Whitman probably created this manuscript sometime in May 1888, since Horace Traubel records that Whitman gave him the essay copy to deliver to the printer on 28 May 1888. (See With Walt Whitman in Camden [Boston: Small, Maynard & Company, 1906] 1:238).

note.p: This draft of a footnote to the essay "A Backward Glance O'er Travel'd Roads" was first printed in the 1888 volume November Boughs, although the essay itself grew out of several previously published pieces.
